transcript: Life requires practice, wins, losses, success, everything in between requires us to practice. In turn, when we practice, we learn how we respond in situations. We learn how we react when it comes to when things don't go our way. The more that we practice and the more that we explore and the more that we experience, we learn acceptance and we become a master of ourselves. And practice teaches us how to master who we are in our internal world without letting the external world navigate and dictate the direction that we go.
